method: Read the twelve architecture documents in order and independently recorded every status marker, artifact/version reference, topology assertion, confinement claim, and mutable/immutable state claim.
Compared only after that read against the authoritative claim register and current artifact filenames.
Traced cost/shape assertions into steering to test whether incumbent measurements had been promoted through all three evidence-promotion tests.
Inspected checker source where a clean checker result conflicted with a visible status or confinement statement.
scopeAxes: greenfield decision justified by incumbent cost/shape/compatibility

resolves.B-ARCH-01: OPEN-BLOCKER: architecture/10 presents complete mechanical claim-status enforcement under SEALED while METHOD.CLAIM-STATUS-INTEGRITY is CANDIDATE and known incomplete.
resolves.B-ARCH-02: OPEN-BLOCKER: architecture/07 and /11 cite superseded D9/R1 artifacts and /11 still says P-4 is open; the traceability summary is not current.
resolves.B-ARCH-03: OPEN-BLOCKER: the SEALED cold-path rationale promotes the incumbent Node/module-resolution measurement without demonstrating transport to a target host or representative target workload.
resolves.B-ARCH-04: OPEN-BLOCKER: R-1 says only core lifetime-neutrality is closable, but /08 simultaneously makes a full one-shot host mandatory and labels that deployment choice not in doubt.
resolves.B-ARCH-05: OPEN-BLOCKER: /05 calls Probe an ephemeral sandbox in a skipped table and seals effectful-work unrepresentability despite admitting no signature/label is a capability boundary and no enforcement mechanism exists.
resolves.B-ARCH-06: OPEN-BLOCKER: /02's immutable Run conflicts with /06 RT-2's mutable currentTier inside a Run.
resolves.B-ARCH-07: OPEN-BLOCKER: zero-egress threat/offline claims conflict with explicitly network-granted Probe execution inside the analysis DAG.
resolves.B-ARCH-08: OPEN-BLOCKER: the evidence model universalizes single source spans even though relational, aggregate, and negative facts require witness/provenance sets and universe commitments.
resolves.B-ARCH-09: OPEN-BLOCKER: /00 says the evidence engine is settled and lists /06 as SEALED while C-2, retention tiers, termination, fact identity, and resolved inputs remain candidate.
resolves.B-ARCH-10: OPEN-BLOCKER: the C-2 Plan boundary has three live forms: /03 Snapshotter-before-Planner, /05 a public Snapshot stage, and v2 an outer InvocationPlan with no inner Snapshot stage.
resolves.B-ARCH-11: OPEN-BLOCKER: /11 claims the original agents log is intact and is the source for 40 agreement items, but the available log is a fresh current-review log and contains no recoverable prior deliberation.

evidence: architecture/10-method.md marks all method rules SEALED
rule 8 says the register/checker mechanically enforce status and the Error 5 section says status now lives in one place and the checker asserts no restatement exceeds it
claim-register.v1.json marks METHOD.CLAIM-STATUS-INTEGRITY CANDIDATE and lists incomplete inventory, hand-enumerated restatements, weak probes, and missing mutation tests
check-claims.py passes despite the stale statements found in B-ARCH-02 and this stronger-status restatement
findings.impact: The document set repeats Error 5 in the section claiming Error 5 has been structurally prevented.
findings.requiredChange: Separate the sealed method invariant from the candidate enforcement-completeness claim. Mark the latter inline CANDIDATE everywhere, add resolvable claim IDs/probes for all restatements, and mutation-test each historical/current false-negative form before making a completeness claim.

evidence: architecture/07 says d9-exit-contract.v1.1 with 37 cases is binding and v1.2 is future work
the claim register and architecture/09 identify d9-exit-contract.v1.4 with 39 cases as binding
architecture/11 lists D9 v1.2 and R1 v1 and says P-4 is open
the register binds D9 v1.4, R1 v1.1, and records P-4 SEALED with product disposition
findings.impact: A reader following prose reaches superseded contracts and wrong decision states even though the register checker reports clean.
findings.requiredChange: Regenerate or mechanically validate every architecture artifact reference and status summary against the register. Replace narrative round snapshots with clearly historical blocks or remove them from current-state sections.
findings.claimStatusRecommendation: No promotion; METHOD.CLAIM-STATUS-INTEGRITY gains this blocker

evidence: architecture/08 seals 'Startup cost is dominated by module and dependency resolution topology' as the premise for three cold-path tiers
steering/01-current-state-evidence.md M10 records the same claim from the shipping Node bootstrap and eager compiler/grammar loading
architecture/00 itself says the measurement still needs external validity and a representative target workload
the target is described as a systems-language host, so the causal mechanism is not invariant
findings.impact: An incumbent composition-root defect is promoted into a universal greenfield premise in direct violation of METHOD.EVIDENCE-PROMOTION.
findings.requiredChange: Remove the dominance claim or mark it target-specific candidate. Re-derive static/manifest/full separation from target-independent merits such as minimal authority, failure isolation, and bounded startup, then benchmark it on named target builds/workloads before using cost as evidence.
findings.claimStatusRecommendation: Do not seal the empirical dominance premise; ARCH.COLDPATH-TIERS may retain its status only after a merit-only rationale is independently accepted

evidence: architecture/08 and /09 say only R-1(1), lifetime-neutral core, is closable without measurement
architecture/08 'What is not in doubt' says a full-capability one-shot host is mandatory
offline operation, CI, and recovery do not logically require process-per-command execution; each can be satisfied by other local ephemeral or managed host shapes
findings.impact: A deployment decision is smuggled into the invariant list while topology is formally REOPENED, preserving the incumbent one-shot shape by assertion.
findings.requiredChange: Treat one-shot availability as a separate product/topology candidate with alternatives and falsifiable requirements. Keep only the invariant that no chosen local lifetime may depend on an unavailable network service and recovery has a bounded local path.
findings.claimStatusRecommendation: R-1 remains REOPENED; PO-01 must not be treated as sealed
findings.confidence: high that status is inconsistent; medium on the eventual topology choice

evidence: architecture/05 Execution tiers labels Probe 'Ephemeral sandbox' without specifying OS confinement
the same document says process isolation is only fault containment and in-language signatures/labels are not boundaries
C-2 v2 knownLimitations says PS-09 assumes a runtime denial mechanism no artifact designs
first-party imperative rules are linked TCB and therefore retain ambient authority in ordinary native/module runtimes
check-threat-claims.py skips Markdown tables
findings.impact: The architecture seals the exact ambient-authority escape hatch that Error 2 says a signature or enum cannot close, while the ship checker cannot see the claim.
findings.requiredChange: Reopen ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT's unrepresentability claim. Define the actual enforcement substrate for each code form, or weaken first-party TCB language to 'not supplied through the Rule API' and stop claiming effectful work is unrepresentable. Qualify the Probe row as OS-confined only when a named profile is active.
findings.claimStatusRecommendation: REOPEN ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT pending an enforceable capability artifact

evidence: architecture/02 defines Run as immutable and sealed
architecture/06 RT-1 puts tier in the sealed Run manifest
architecture/06 RT-2 says the Run records currentTier and that it degrades after retention expiry
findings.impact: Retention GC either mutates an immutable evidence object or leaves its declared availability false.
findings.requiredChange: Keep sealedTier and proof commitments immutable in the Run; move current availability to an append-only retention ledger/tombstone projection.

evidence: threat-model R1 says zero egress on the analysis path
architecture/03 allows workflow-granted network
architecture/05 gives Probe explicit per-Plan network grants and places Probe in the typed analysis DAG
findings.impact: Offline and privacy gates have no stable subject and can make incompatible claims about the same Run.
findings.requiredChange: Define a zero-egress deterministic analysis profile and separately type effectful Probe plans. Never attach the zero-egress claim to a Plan carrying network grants.

evidence: architecture/04 says every fact carries a source span
the same document includes derived reachability, cycles, blast radius, and negative-reference facts
architecture/06 T1 assumes the spans each finding cited explain why
findings.impact: Global/derived/negative claims are forced into a lint-finding evidence shape, causing the T1 proof failure and leaving provenance incomplete.
findings.requiredChange: Replace mandatory single sourceSpan with a typed provenance/proof union: source span, relation-edge witness, derivation inputs, aggregate/set commitment, or negative-universe/Coverage certificate. Require source spans only where semantically applicable.
findings.claimStatusRecommendation: No sealed fact/proof schema should be inferred until a checkable schema exists

evidence: architecture/00 says 'The evidence engine is settled'
its document map labels architecture/06 SEALED without noting ARCH.RETENTION-TIERS
the claim register marks C-2, D9, ARCH.RETENTION-TIERS, RESOLVED-INPUTS, FACT-IDENTITY, TM, OPERABILITY, and DELIVERY non-sealed
findings.impact: The opening summary gives candidate contract details the authority of a completed engine design.
findings.requiredChange: Replace 'settled' with a precise list of sealed invariants and candidate contract surfaces. Mark /06 mixed in the document map as is already done for /03, /05, and /08.
findings.claimStatusRecommendation: No individual status change; fix the container/summary

evidence: architecture/03 canonical flow is Snapshotter then Planner
architecture/05 candidate stage table includes Snapshot as a Plan stage
c2-plan-stage-schema.v2 says InvocationPlan captures snapshot and ExecutionPlan rejects snapshot stages
claim-register.v1.json still names c2-plan-stage-schema.v1.json as binding
findings.impact: There is no single candidate Plan boundary for implementers or reviewers to test.
findings.requiredChange: Adjudicate v2, update the binding artifact only after review, and then update all prose/restatements together. Do not leave v1 prose and v2 artifacts simultaneously normative.

evidence: architecture/11 calls agents-log.md intact and the source for the three-agent deliberation and 40 agreement items
the available agents-log.md begins with the current Reviewer A entry and current-understanding stub; it does not contain the prior deliberation or 40 agreement items
the assignment states the prior deliberation logs were lost
findings.impact: Traceability claims an origin chain that cannot be audited, weakening every 'agreement item' provenance assertion.
findings.requiredChange: Mark the agreement-item origin as lost/reconstructed, identify which surviving artifacts independently support each claim, and stop citing the fresh log as original evidence.
findings.claimStatusRecommendation: Treat unbacked agreement-origin claims as CANDIDATE/RECONSTRUCTED

sealedPropertiesCovered.assessment: Correct invariant; completeness of its current checker is overstated and remains candidate.
Contradicted by the Probe sandbox table and unimplemented Rule denial claim.
Correctly reopened in principle; one-shot mandatory language partially reseals it.
Correctly candidate; current prose and v2 disagree on its boundary.

noFindingPasses.checked: Compared architecture/02 and /06 for producer-vs-host computation.
noFindingPasses.result: No contradiction found: both make computation host-owned.
noFindingPasses.whatWouldChangeMyMind: A producer contract or projection that accepts a producer-minted durable fingerprint.

noFindingPasses.result: No contradiction found: latest remains a resolver that returns the exact selected identity.
noFindingPasses.whatWouldChangeMyMind: A surface that records latest without the resolved Run ID.

noFindingPasses.result: The storage-protocol obligation is consistently deployment-independent.
noFindingPasses.whatWouldChangeMyMind: A host-specific write path or mirror authority.

knownLimitations: This audit did not re-derive every sealed architecture decision from first principles; it targeted the three assigned axes plus contradictions exposed while tracing them.
No OpenSIP graph answer was used, so the known wrong-project MCP binding could not contaminate the findings.

I inspected the current agents log after completing the document read in order to append in its current format; this exposed Reviewer A's summary. I did not inspect Reviewer A's review JSON. Findings here are tied to direct document/checker evidence.
whatWouldChangeOverallVerdict: A synchronized document revision that marks enforcement completeness honestly, updates all binding artifact/status references, removes or re-derives the incumbent cold-start premise, restores R-1 openness, defines a real capability boundary, separates mutable retention availability from immutable Runs, and reconstructs traceability without claiming the lost log is intact.
